name: @dialoguebranch/client-js
description: Playback-only JavaScript client for a Dialogue Branch Web Service (no authoring).
author: Fruit Tree Labs (https://www.fruittreelabs.com)

scripts.sync-version: node -e "import('../../global.json', {with:{type:'json'}}).then(g => { const fs = require('fs'); const p = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('./package.json')); p.version = g.default.version; fs.writeFileSync('./package.json', JSON.stringify(p, null, 2) + '\n'); })"
